grammar.purpose: Distinguish a purpose from a recipient or cause
grammar.explanation: 为了方便带书 states the intended goal. 为朋友准备礼物 identifies the beneficiary instead. 因为她喜欢读书 gives a cause motivating the choice. An intended purpose is not proof that the goal has already been achieved; ask whether the bag fits the recipient’s books.

examples.zh: 为了方便带书，我选了布袋。
examples.py: wèi le fāng biàn dài shū , wǒ xuǎn le bù dài .
examples.en: To make carrying books easier, I chose a cloth bag.

examples.zh: 为了纪念第一次见面，我选了照片。
examples.py: wèi le jì niàn dì yī cì jiàn miàn , wǒ xuǎn le zhào piān .
examples.en: To commemorate the first meeting, I chose a photo.

examples.zh: 因为她喜欢读书，我为她准备布袋。
examples.py: yīn wèi tā xǐ huān dú shū , wǒ wèi tā zhǔn bèi bù dài .
examples.en: Because she likes reading, I prepared a cloth bag for her.

commonMistakes.wrong: 为了方便带书，所以已经证明袋子合适。
commonMistakes.right: 为了方便带书选布袋，还要看大小是否合适。
commonMistakes.why: An intention does not verify suitability.

grammar.purpose: Link an intended purpose to the chosen action
grammar.explanation: 为了节约材料，我用了已有的纸 presents goal then action. It does not require 所以; distinguish causal 因为……所以 from purposive 为了. The alternative 我用了已有的纸，为了节约材料 is possible with context, but the exercise asks for the ordinary initial-purpose ordering. Keep the action concrete and verify the result separately.

examples.zh: 为了节约材料，我用了已有的纸。
examples.py: wèi le jié yuē cái liào , wǒ yòng le yǐ yǒu de zhǐ .
examples.en: To save materials, I used paper already available.

examples.zh: 为了让她方便带书，我选了布袋。
examples.py: wèi le ràng tā fāng biàn dài shū , wǒ xuǎn le bù dài .
examples.en: To let her carry books conveniently, I chose a cloth bag.

examples.zh: 为了说明作者，我在卡片上写了名字。
examples.py: wèi le shuō míng zuò zhě , wǒ zài kǎ piàn shàng xiě le míng zi .
examples.en: To identify the creator, I wrote the name on the card.

commonMistakes.wrong: 为了她喜欢读书，我买了袋子。
commonMistakes.right: 因为她喜欢读书，我买了袋子。
commonMistakes.why: Her existing preference is a cause; use 为了 for a goal to achieve.

lines.zh: 小周生日，你准备送什么？
lines.py: xiǎo zhōu shēng rì , nǐ zhǔn bèi sòng shén me ?
lines.en: What are you giving Xiao Zhou for her birthday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我做了一个布袋，她平时带书，可以用。
lines.py: wǒ zuò le yī gè bù dài , tā píng shí dài shū , kě yǐ yòng .
lines.en: I made a cloth bag. She carries books, so it should be useful.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你自己设计的？让我看看。
lines.py: nǐ zì jǐ shè jì de ? ràng wǒ kàn kàn .
lines.en: You designed it yourself? Let me see.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 蓝色的布，里面加了一层，袋口有个扣子。
lines.py: lán sè de bù , lǐ miàn jiā le yī céng , dài kǒu yǒu gè kòu zi .
lines.en: Blue cloth, with another layer inside and a button at the opening.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 金色扣子？不会真是金的吧？
lines.py: jīn sè kòu zi ? bù huì zhēn shì jīn de ba ?
lines.en: A gold-coloured button? Don't tell me it's real gold?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 想得美，就是普通扣子，好看一点。
lines.py: xiǎng de měi , jiù shì pǔ tōng kòu zi , hǎo kàn yī diǎn .
lines.en: You wish. It's an ordinary button. Just looks nice.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那这张彩色卡也是你做的？
lines.py: nà zhè zhāng cǎi sè kǎ yě shì nǐ zuò de ?
lines.en: Did you make this coloured card too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，用了我们上次旅行的照片。她看见应该会笑。
lines.py: duì , yòng le wǒ men shàng cì lǚ xíng de zhào piān . tā kàn jiàn yīng gāi huì xiào .
lines.en: Yes. With a photo from our last trip. It should make her laugh.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 哪张？不会是她拿着两杯茶那张吧？
lines.py: nǎ zhāng ? bù huì shì tā ná zhe liǎng bēi chá nà zhāng ba ?
lines.en: Which one? Not the one where she's holding two cups of tea?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 就是那张，卡上写祝你每天都有好茶。
lines.py: jiù shì nà zhāng , kǎ shàng xiě zhù nǐ měi tiān dōu yǒu hǎo chá .
lines.en: That's the one. The card wishes her good tea every day.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那袋子是不是应该装茶，不装书？
lines.py: nà dài zi shì bú shì yīng gāi zhuāng chá , bù zhuāng shū ?
lines.en: Should the bag hold tea rather than books, then?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先装书吧，茶倒进去就不好洗了。
lines.py: xiān zhuāng shū ba , chá dào jìn qù jiù bù hǎo xǐ le .
lines.en: Books first. Tea poured inside would be hard to wash out.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A gift note without inflated claims
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 小周生日快到了，我想给她做一个能装书的布袋。家里有一块蓝色布，我先画了设计图，再把里面加上一层。
lines.py: xiǎo zhōu shēng rì kuài dào le , wǒ xiǎng gěi tā zuò yī gè néng zhuāng shū de bù dài . jiā lǐ yǒu yī kuài lán sè bù , wǒ xiān huà le shè jì tú , zài bǎ lǐ miàn jiā shàng yī céng .
lines.en: Xiao Zhou's birthday was approaching. I wanted to make her a cloth book bag. I had blue cloth at home, drew a design and added an inner layer.

lines.zh: 袋口需要一个扣子，我去附近的小店买。银色和金色都有，我选了金色，付了五元现金，回家把它缝好。
lines.py: dài kǒu xū yào yī gè kòu zi , wǒ qù fù jìn de xiǎo diàn mǎi . yín sè hé jīn sè dōu yǒu , wǒ xuǎn le jīn sè , fù le wǔ yuán xiàn jīn , huí jiā bǎ tā fèng hǎo .
lines.en: I needed a button for the opening and went to the nearby shop. It had silver-coloured and gold-coloured ones. I chose gold-coloured, paid five yuan in cash and sewed it on at home.

lines.zh: 陈宇来看袋子，问是不是我自己设计的。我说是，这个袋子只能手提，不过装书很方便。他把自己的书放进去，两本都装下了。
lines.py: chén yǔ lái kàn dài zi , wèn shì bú shì wǒ zì jǐ shè jì de . wǒ shuō shì , zhè gè dài zi zhǐ néng shǒu tí , bù guò zhuāng shū hěn fāng biàn . tā bǎ zì jǐ de shū fàng jìn qù , liǎng běn dōu zhuāng xià le .
lines.en: Chen Yu came to see the bag and asked if I'd designed it. Yes; it could only be carried by hand, but was handy for books. He tried his books, and both fitted.

lines.zh: 我又做了一张彩色卡，用了上次旅行时小周拿着两杯茶的照片。为了让她想起那一天，我写了祝你每天都有好茶。
lines.py: wǒ yòu zuò le yī zhāng cǎi sè kǎ , yòng le shàng cì lǚ xíng shí xiǎo zhōu ná zhe liǎng bēi chá de zhào piān . wèi le ràng tā xiǎng qǐ nà yī tiān , wǒ xiě le zhù nǐ měi tiān dōu yǒu hǎo chá .
lines.en: I made a coloured card with the travel photo of Xiao Zhou holding two cups of tea. To remind her of that day I wrote a wish for good tea every day.

lines.zh: 生日那天，她打开袋子，先看见卡，就笑了。她说那天明明是替陈宇拿茶，照片里却像两杯都是自己的。
lines.py: shēng rì nà tiān , tā dǎ kāi dài zi , xiān kàn jiàn kǎ , jiù xiào le . tā shuō nà tiān míng míng shì tì chén yǔ ná chá , zhào piān lǐ què xiàng liǎng bēi dōu shì zì jǐ de .
lines.en: On her birthday she opened the bag, saw the card and laughed. She'd actually been holding Chen Yu's tea that day, but the photo made both cups look like hers.

lines.zh: 她把卡收进袋子，说这张要留作纪念，书也正好能放。我问扣子喜欢吗，她说喜欢，像袋口有一点小太阳。
lines.py: tā bǎ kǎ shōu jìn dài zi , shuō zhè zhāng yào liú zuò jì niàn , shū yě zhèng hǎo néng fàng . wǒ wèn kòu zi xǐ huān ma , tā shuō xǐ huān , xiàng dài kǒu yǒu yī diǎn xiǎo tài yáng .
lines.en: She put the card into the bag, saying she'd keep it as a souvenir and her books would fit too. Did she like the button? Yes; it was like a little sun at the bag's opening.

She asks for all the cash back

extraReadings.purpose: Understand each word in a different situation.

lines.zh: 为了赶车，我们早点出门。
lines.py: wèi le gǎn chē , wǒ men zǎo diǎn chū mén .
lines.en: We're leaving early to catch the bus.

lines.zh: 我买这个袋子，是为了装书。
lines.py: wǒ mǎi zhè gè dài zi , shì wèi le zhuāng shū .
lines.en: I bought this bag to carry books.

lines.zh: 这次义卖是爱心活动。
lines.py: zhè cì yì mài shì ài xīn huó dòng .
lines.en: This charity sale is an act of care for others.

lines.zh: 她很有爱心，经常照顾邻居的猫。
lines.py: tā hěn yǒu ài xīn , jīng cháng zhào gù lín jū de māo .
lines.en: She's caring and often looks after her neighbour's cat.

lines.zh: 这个杯子是谁设计的？
lines.py: zhè gè bēi zi shì shéi shè jì de ?
lines.en: Who designed this cup?

lines.zh: 我想自己设计一张生日卡。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng zì jǐ shè jì yī zhāng shēng rì kǎ .
lines.en: I'd like to design a birthday card myself.

lines.zh: 她正在创作一首歌。
lines.py: tā zhèng zài chuàng zuò yī shǒu gē .
lines.en: She's creating a song.

lines.zh: 这个故事是他上大学时创作的。
lines.py: zhè gè gù shì shì tā shàng dà xué shí chuàng zuò de .
lines.en: He created this story when he was at university.

lines.zh: 大家一起创造了新的机会。
lines.py: dà jiā yì qǐ chuàng zào le xīn de jī huì .
lines.en: Everyone created new opportunities together.

lines.zh: 她想给孩子创造一个安静的环境。
lines.py: tā xiǎng gěi hái zi chuàng zào yī gè ān jìng de huán jìng .
lines.en: She wants to create a quiet environment for the child.

lines.zh: 这家店的菜总有一点创新。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn de cài zǒng yǒu yī diǎn chuàng xīn .
lines.en: This shop's dishes always have a little innovation.

lines.zh: 他在设计上做了一些创新。
lines.py: tā zài shè jì shàng zuò le yī xiē chuàng xīn .
lines.en: He introduced some innovations in the design.

lines.zh: 这是她最近的作品。
lines.py: zhè shì tā zuì jìn de zuò pǐn .
lines.en: This is her latest work.

lines.zh: 展览里有学生的作品。
lines.py: zhǎn lǎn lǐ yǒu xué sheng de zuò pǐn .
lines.en: The exhibition includes students' work.

lines.zh: 这本书的作者是谁？
lines.py: zhè běn shū de zuò zhě shì shéi ?
lines.en: Who's the author of this book?

lines.zh: 我想给作者写一封信。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi zuò zhě xiě yī fēng xìn .
lines.en: I'd like to write a letter to the author.

lines.zh: 你带彩色笔了吗？
lines.py: nǐ dài cǎi sè bǐ le ma ?
lines.en: Have you brought coloured pens?

lines.zh: 我想把这张照片打印成彩色的。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè zhāng zhào piān dǎ yìn chéng cǎi sè de .
lines.en: I'd like to print this photo in colour.

lines.zh: 我用这块布做了一个袋子。
lines.py: wǒ yòng zhè kuài bù zuò le yī gè dài zi .
lines.en: I made a bag with this piece of cloth.

lines.zh: 桌上的布是蓝色的。
lines.py: zhuō shàng de bù shì lán sè de .
lines.en: The cloth on the table is blue.

lines.zh: 她戴着一条金项链。
lines.py: tā dài zhe yī tiáo jīn xiàng liàn .
lines.en: She's wearing a gold necklace.

lines.zh: 这个小盒子是金做的。
lines.py: zhè gè xiǎo hé zi shì jīn zuò de .
lines.en: This little box is made of gold.

lines.zh: 这只戒指是银做的。
lines.py: zhè zhǐ jiè zhǐ shì yín zuò de .
lines.en: This ring is made of silver.

lines.zh: 她买了一对银耳环。
lines.py: tā mǎi le yī duì yín ěr huán .
lines.en: She bought a pair of silver earrings.

lines.zh: 这张票我留着做纪念。
lines.py: zhè zhāng piào wǒ liú zhe zuò jì niàn .
lines.en: I'm keeping this ticket as a souvenir.

lines.zh: 我想纪念第一次自己旅行。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng jì niàn dì yī cì zì jǐ lǚ xíng .
lines.en: I'd like to commemorate my first trip alone.

lines.zh: 祝你生日快乐！
lines.py: zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè !
lines.en: Happy birthday!

lines.zh: 祝你旅途顺利。
lines.py: zhù nǐ lǚ tú shùn lì .
lines.en: Have a smooth journey.

lines.zh: 旧纸也能用，可以节约一点。
lines.py: jiù zhǐ yě néng yòng , kě yǐ jié yuē yī diǎn .
lines.en: We can use the old paper and save a little.

lines.zh: 关掉不用的灯，节约用电。
lines.py: guān diào bù yòng de dēng , jié yuē yòng diàn .
lines.en: Switch off unused lights to save electricity.

lines.zh: 买了不吃，就浪费了。
lines.py: mǎi le bù chī , jiù làng fèi le .
lines.en: Buying it and not eating it wastes it.

lines.zh: 别浪费时间找了，我这里还有一支。
lines.py: bié làng fèi shí jiān zhǎo le , wǒ zhè lǐ hái yǒu yī zhī .
lines.en: Don't waste time looking. I have another one here.

lines.zh: 我想利用周末整理房间。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng lì yòng zhōu mò zhěng lǐ fáng jiān .
lines.en: I'd like to use the weekend to organise the room.

lines.zh: 这块空地方可以利用起来。
lines.py: zhè kuài kòng dì fāng kě yǐ lì yòng qǐ lái .
lines.en: We can make use of this empty space.

lines.zh: 这个包有防水的功能吗？
lines.py: zhè gè bāo yǒu fáng shuǐ de gōng néng ma ?
lines.en: Does this bag have a waterproofing function?

lines.zh: 手机这个功能我还不会用。
lines.py: shǒu jī zhè gè gōng néng wǒ hái bù huì yòng .
lines.en: I don't know how to use this phone feature yet.

lines.zh: 这个办法适用于小房间。
lines.py: zhè gè bàn fǎ shì yòng yú xiǎo fáng jiān .
lines.en: This method is suitable for small rooms.

lines.zh: 这张卡适用的商店有哪些？
lines.py: zhè zhāng kǎ shì yòng de shāng diàn yǒu nǎ xiē ?
lines.en: Which shops can this card be used at?

lines.zh: 他把学到的方法应用在工作中。
lines.py: tā bǎ xué dào de fāng fǎ yìng yòng zài gōng zuò zhōng .
lines.en: He applied what he'd learned at work.

lines.zh: 这个手机应用很好用。
lines.py: zhè gè shǒu jī yìng yòng hěn hǎo yòng .
lines.en: This phone app is useful.

lines.zh: 这家店消费不高。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn xiāo fèi bù gāo .
lines.en: It doesn't cost much to eat at this shop.

lines.zh: 我想减少不必要的消费。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng jiǎn shǎo bù bì yào de xiāo fèi .
lines.en: I'd like to cut unnecessary spending.

lines.zh: 可以付现金吗？
lines.py: kě yǐ fù xiàn jīn ma ?
lines.en: Can I pay in cash?

lines.zh: 我没带现金，用手机付吧。
lines.py: wǒ méi dài xiàn jīn , yòng shǒu jī fù ba .
lines.en: I don't have cash. I'll pay with my phone.

audio.zh: 蓝色的布，里面加了一层，袋口有个扣子。
audio.py: lán sè de bù , lǐ miàn jiā le yī céng , dài kǒu yǒu gè kòu zi .
audio.en: Blue cloth, with another layer inside and a button at the opening.

tasks.why: The heard line explicitly states this fact.

audio.zh: 她把卡收进袋子，说这张要留作纪念，书也正好能放。我问扣子喜欢吗，她说喜欢，像袋口有一点小太阳。
audio.py: tā bǎ kǎ shōu jìn dài zi , shuō zhè zhāng yào liú zuò jì niàn , shū yě zhèng hǎo néng fàng . wǒ wèn kòu zi xǐ huān ma , tā shuō xǐ huān , xiàng dài kǒu yǒu yī diǎn xiǎo tài yáng .
audio.en: She put the card into the bag, saying she'd keep it as a souvenir and her books would fit too. Did she like the button? Yes; it was like a little sun at the bag's opening.

tasks.why: The heard line explicitly states a different result.

AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三26, 三72. Native check: 为了 purpose versus 因为 cause and 为 beneficiary, 适用 versus 适合, 彩色 as modifier, 创作 versus 创造, 金/银 colour-material contrast, gift politeness and gold-plating metaphor. Original card/scene only, no copied lyrics or scripts. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三20 / 三29 / 三24 / 三41: 活动由学生举办。, 按名单分组，不按到达时间。, 向主人问清楚时间。, 像平时一样，先问时间。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Naturalness correction: a quiet tea/book meeting for a tired friend, Grandma sharing opera stories over a home visit, correcting a west/east gate mistake with an apology and water, and a handmade birthday book bag/photo card. No identity, copyright or assessment-policy lecture inside ordinary speech. All 88 word records retain IDs and get two independent contexts; abstract/formal senses use suitable separate sentences. Self-review: Chen Yu offers the quiet venue; Grandma expects Sunday three and oranges; only Lin An goes to wrong gate, Chen Yu sends old address and fetches her; blue cloth, ordinary gold-coloured five-yuan button, birthday recipient Xiao Zhou, two books fit. Every false statement contradicts its own clip. Native flags: 感情/情感/感受, 自主 and 客观 register, 民族/中华民族/华人 definitions, civilisation/courteous 文明, printed 由于/因此/声明, 补/完善, 创作/创造/创新, 适用/应用, and playful 想得美/塞给. Native review pending.
